name: get_transcript
title: Get transcript
description: Return the timestamped transcript segments of one source of a meeting. `source` selects which transcript: `merged` (default) = the integrated transcript (merged/merged.json) with speaker labels resolved to names; `own-mic` / `own-system` = the raw transcription of the microphone / system-audio track; `ext-<context_id>` = a parsed external transcript registered with register_context. `speaker_map` maps speaker labels (me / other / SPEAKER_00 …) to resolved display names (null = unresolved; minutes show such speakers as 話者不明) with a 0..1 confidence. `available_sources` lists every source that currently exists for the meeting. Segment times are seconds from the recording start. Read-only. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting, or the requested source has not been produced yet — check available_sources and the processing job), scope_denied, invalid_argument (malformed source), internal.

source.description: Transcript source id: merged (default) | own-mic | own-system | ext-<context_id> (e.g. ext-ctx-0123abcd).

scope.description: Omitted = unscoped meetings only. One name = that scope + unscoped. Array of 2+ names = cross-scope lookup (audit-logged).

source.description: The source id that was returned.

segments.description: Segments in time order. For `merged`, `speaker` is the label and `speaker_name` the resolved name (null if unresolved).

name.description: Resolved display name, or null when unresolved.

available_sources.description: Source ids that exist for this meeting right now (subset of merged / own-mic / own-system / ext-<context_id>).

segments.text: 先週のオンボーディングの進捗から共有します。
segments.speaker: other
